integrity: The included standalone exact census traverses all 3*2^(n-1) unclustered ternary last columns with sound published parity pruning; independent direct-rotation verification covers all 115 nonempty Parikh classes. The finite proof is computational and limited to stated cutoff.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete enumeration only for ternary n=13..30; no general n theorem. Prior published parity and cyclic-run inequality are used. Full text of the closest recent preprint unavailable; historical priority remains provisional. Independent external validation not performed.
title: Sharp ternary Burrows–Wheeler Parikh spectra through length 30
